title: Preference-dependent digital systems
summary: Reviews in this topic say the vehicle’s appeal depends on buyer preferences, while one review also warns that heavy reliance on digital systems can become a serious problem in some situations.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the vehicle can suit the owner well depending on what they personally like.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback says preference matters but also raises concern that dependence on digital systems can create serious problems in certain situations.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback only states that the judgment depends on what the buyer is looking for, without a clear positive or negative stance.

limitations: The topic is based on very few fragments, so examples are insufficient for a fuller breakdown of specific situations or systems.
The fragments are brief and partly conditional, which limits confidence about the exact underlying issue beyond preference-dependence and a general concern about digital systems.
